description: This PHP source file defines a class AOR_ReportsViewEdit extending a ViewEdit class, responsible for handling the editing view of reports in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for rendering the page with CSS and JavaScript, and for retrieving associated condition, field, and chart data related to report editing.

classes.name: AOR_ReportsViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit that handles the custom display and data fetching logic for report editing within the SuiteCRM module, including rendering CSS/JS and retrieving related conditions, fields, and charts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the AOR_ReportsViewEdit object by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares and outputs necessary CSS and JavaScript for the report editing page, including language cache, options, and current report data like fields, conditions, and charts.

methods.name: getConditionLines
methods.description: Retrieves related condition records for the current report, decoding and processing their data for display.

methods.name: getFieldLines
methods.description: Retrieves related field records for the current report, including display labels and types.

methods.name: getChartLines
methods.description: Retrieves linked chart records associated with the report.
